messages:
linh: alert: multiple region health checks failing for sf2 — control-plane API intermittent, host-level agent reporting OOMs and kubelet evictions, LB returning 502. Observed spike in GPU pod OOMs around 14:02 UTC. :rotating_light:

alex_m: oncall here. Can someone paste top node error? tagging @jamie_infra

jamie_infra: looking. Nodes are flapping. kubelet log shows 'eviction manager: attempting to reclaim resources' and containerd restarting. NVidia driver errors in dmesg intermittently. Suspect kernel/driver interaction after today's host patch.

sara_ops: Dedicated pools in sf2 show ~75% GPU capacity lost within 10m. We need to shift hosted traffic off sf2 ASAP. FYI cross-region egress will increase costs.

alex_m: initiating traffic-shift to reduce load on sf2. Plan: route 80% to west1, 20% to eu-central as fallback. Running the route change now.

alex_m: command: `curl -s -X POST https://console.internal/api/route-shift -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"from":"sf2","to":["west1","eu-central"],"weights":[80,20]}'`

deploy-bot: Deployment started: route-shift/1858702468 by alex_m. Rollout 1/3 in progress.

jamie_infra: cordoning affected node pool (gpu-pool-7). Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-7-node-3` then `kubectl drain gpu-pool-7-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Collecting kernel & driver logs.

linh: notes: after partial shift we see KV cache miss rate x3 on west1, short-chat latency up ~200ms for a subset of requests. Likely cold caches + different batch packing.

sara_ops: can we enable prefix cache reuse or warm workers on west1? If not, reduce batch size for latency-sensitive routes to avoid tail latency spike.

alex_m: lowered chat route batch_size 8 -> 4 for west1: `redwoodctl set-config --route chat --batch 4 --region west1`. Monitoring impact.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created: I-8942 (Sev: 1). Notifying eng-sre, eng-runtime, infra oncall.

jamie_infra: dug into host patch history — there was a kernel micro-update pushed at 02:19 UTC to sf2 host image. Reproduced driver OOPS after adding loop of gpu stress on a test host. Rolling back kernel on one node for test.

linh: update (14:17 UTC): control plane partial recovery for some tenants, but ~40% GPU hosts still show driver crash loop. Traffic remains shifted. Continues triage. Will post follow-up in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
